chapter: Averty's letters and Tom Brown's claims
title: Averty's checks of New York newspapers and the Louisiana Five
summary: Averty compares Brown's and Cannon's versions, says New York papers show no Brown band in 1915, questions Lada and the Louisiana Five, and lists contract-date discrepancies.
